purpose: Admission records for 20 UK and 12 non-UK bounded parcel qualifications; technical qualification supports local runtime integration and does not establish citywide completeness, legal title, survey accuracy or currentness.

ukSnapshot.metricVerification: Saved full-safe outputs and metric reports were hash-bound and verified; no new independent metric recomputation was performed for this release. HMLR outputs already apply the documented deterministic overlap policy; metric auditing does not further repair or clip them.

evidenceHashNote: Original frozen source bytes are recorded in originalEvidenceHashes. Exported sanitized bytes are recorded in exportedEvidenceHashes; absolute runner paths have been redacted, and full geometry caches remain private. Per-city candidateSha256 and metricReportSha256 retain frozen evidence identities; qualificationSha256 identifies the sanitized export.
